description: This Java class defines constants and utility methods related to authentication mechanisms, message formats, and parsing related to the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AuthenticationConstants
classes.description: Final utility class providing constants and static methods for authentication handling in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: getAuthenticationRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for authenticating a client with specified SASL mechanism and response.

methods.name: getAuthenticationReply
methods.description: Creates a JSON object containing a JWT token representing an authenticated client.

methods.name: getCommonName
methods.description: Extracts the common name (CN) from an X.509 distinguished name string.

methods.name: parseSaslResponse
methods.description: Parses a SASL PLAIN response byte array into its components: authorization ID, authentication ID, and password.
